# Color output adds ANSI escape codes to recipes
mk -color -n -f mkfile
stdout '\x1b\[34m\x1b\[1m\x1b\[4mall\x1b\[0m'
stdout '\x1b\[34mecho hello'
# The colour must be reset before the newline, not after it: a newline
# printed while blue is active can leave colour behind in the terminal.
stdout 'echo hello\x1b\[0m$'
! stdout '^\x1b\[0m'

-- mkfile --
all:V:
	echo hello
